properties.name: Conboy Lab
properties.description:
**Irina Conboy** — University of California, Berkeley, Berkeley, CA (US)

Studies age-imposed and pathological changes in circulatory signaling and their effect on tissue maintenance and repair -- the lab that showed adult stem cell repair capacity is governed by age-changing molecular signals from surrounding tissue (heterochronic parabiosis work). More recently has moved toward synthetic biology and digital biosensors for longitudinal, real-time diagnosis of age-related change and treatment response.

**Why it's on this map:** No current connection to microrobotics, but its work on real-time digital biosensing of aging-related biological change is exactly the kind of long-horizon problem a future distributed in-body monitoring system would need to interface with.

[[https://vcresearch.berkeley.edu/faculty/irina-conboy|Group website]]

properties.name: Fraunhofer IMTE — Cell-based Medical Engineering
properties.description:
**Fraunhofer IMTE — Cell-based Medical Engineering** — Fraunhofer IMTE, Lübeck (DE)

Vision

Fraunhofer IMTE is an innovative and unique research institution developing intelligent systems and processes for health in the fields of medical technology, cell technology and aquaculture. The focus is on the safe translation of these solutions into beneficial applications for a healthy society. With a cycle of prevention, diagnostics, therapy and rehabilitation, we are redefining the term Circular Health and creating ideal conditions for the individualization of health technologies.
Mission

The combination of our competencies in engineering, informatics, aquaculture and cell technology forms a particular strength of research at Fraunhofer IMTE. In this unique combination, they are a unique selling point and at their interface form a new field of research: blue health technologies. To keep our society healthy, we use individual therapeutic and diagnostic methods in close cooperation with the clinic and our customers. In addition, we are tapping into new animal and cell culture models as well as other substance groups from the ocean. Through our central platforms of Surgical Robotics, Food Technology, Additive Manufacturing and Clinical and Regulatory Affairs, the developed solutions are quickly and reliably transferred into application. In this way, we achieve significant added value for the health of our society along the entire value chain and develop it further with agility and competence in line with our concept of Circular Health.

**Why it's on this map:** Works on cell-based medical technology and surgical robotics within a broader 'circular health' research program -- general medical-technology relevance rather than a specific microrobotics tie.

[[https://www.imte.fraunhofer.de/en.html|Group website]]

Category: Medicine Lab · Smallest demonstrated: unknown

properties.name: AGIS — Altern des Individuums und der Gesellschaft
properties.description:
**AGIS — Altern des Individuums und der Gesellschaft** — University of Rostock, Rostock (DE)

Über uns

Eine steigende Lebenserwartung und eine niedrige Geburtenraten verändern die Bevölkerungsstruktur tiefgreifend. Der demografische Wandel gilt als eine der großen Herausforderungen der modernen Industriegesellschaft. Zu seinen Folgen zählen die zunehmende Knappheit an Nachwuchs- und Führungskräften, der Anstieg der Pflegebedürftigkeit und Finanzierungsschwierigkeiten der Sozialversicherungssysteme. Zentrales gesellschaftliches Ziel einer alternden Gesellschaft bleibt die Sicherung des Wohlstands. Das setzt die Aufrechterhaltung der Innovationsfähigkeit, die Verfügbarkeit von Arbeitskräften und die Anpassung der Institutionen an demografischen Veränderungen voraus. Wohlstand bedeutet auch, ein selbständiges und selbstbestimmtes Leben im Alter zu ermöglichen, in Gesundheit und mit voller gesellschaftlicher Teilhabe.

Das Department Altern des Individuums und der Gesellschaft (AGIS) sucht hierfür nach neuen Lösungen – auf der Ebene der medizinischen Versorgungs- und Therapieformen, im Bereich der wirtschaftlichen und sozialen Strukturen und in Bezug auf technische Assistenzsysteme. Voraussetzung hierfür ist eine interdisziplinäre Forschung, die auf Erkenntnissen aus Medizin, Geisteswissenschaften und Ingenieurwissenschaften aufbaut.

**Why it's on this map:** Medicine-lab entry migrated from an earlier map version -- specific current research focus not yet reassessed.

[[https://www.inf.uni-rostock.de/altern-des-individuums-und-der-gesellschaft/|Group website]]

Category: Medicine Lab · Smallest demonstrated: unknown
